items.text: Lamar Jackson listed OUT for Sunday (ankle); Ravens play another game without him.
items.why: ETR Sunday injuries roundup; confirmed multiple sources
items.implication: Tyler Huntley starts again; downgrade Ravens pass catchers slightly, stream Huntley in superflex

items.text: Jalen Hurts OUT (calf/blood clot); first game without him, Tanner McKee starts. Will Shipley also OUT.
items.why: ETR roundup + Rapoport confirmation of first game without
items.implication: McKee QB; top-4 pass catchers healthy (Smith IN) but 4th-string RB

items.text: Breece Hall OUT (quad) along with AD Mitchell; third straight miss.
Eagles ruled out RB Saquon Barkley for Sunday vs Panthers (hamstring).
items.implication: Dameon Pierce likely lead back with Shipley also OUT; thin PHI RB room

items.text: PIT thin at WR (no Pittman/Wilson/Skowronek): expect lots of 2-WR with Metcalf + Germie Bernard. PHI McKee + healthy top-4 pass-catchers (DeVonta/Goedert/Wicks/Lemon) despite 4th-string RB Pierce.
items.why: Depth chart + health notes from injury report
items.implication: Metcalf target spike potential; PHI pass catchers viable with McKee

items.text: Unclear on Qs AJ Brown (ankle), TreVeyon Henderson (ankle), DJ Moore (shoulder). Tyler Warren Friday Q add (groin). Many other Qs more probable: Caleb Williams, DK Metcalf, Chris Olave, Rico Dowdle.
items.why: Practice this week but limited info; Warren new Friday tag
items.implication: Monitor for final; probable ones safer starts
items.opportunity: If Brown/Henderson out, NE WR/RB handcuffs; PIT 2-WR Metcalf/Bernard

items.implication: HOU RB1 opportunity to next man

items.text: IN/cleared: Ladd McConkey, Quentin Johnston, DeVonta Smith, CeeDee Lamb, Ashton Jeanty, Michael Penix, Marvin Harrison Jr.
items.why: ETR Sunday injuries IN section; Schefter McConkey no designation
items.implication: Full roles expected; reverse any prior beneficiary assumptions

items.text: Josh Jacobs removed from commissioner exempt list Monday; eligible to practice/play Week 7. Investigation remains open.
items.implication: GB RB depth/ROS upgrade next week

items.text: LOVE Mike Evans vs WSH as WR4; Washington defense buffet for pass catchers.
LOVE Drake London (WR6 vs CHI usage), George Kittle (TE3 vs WSH), Kyren Williams (RB5 elite usage vs ARI), Javonte Williams (RB8 goal-line vs GB), Rhamondre Stevenson (RB9 volume vs NYJ).
HATE Jaylen Waddle (WR28 vs SEA), Emeka Egbuka (WR34 vs PIT), Kyle Pitts (TE18 vs CHI), Bo Nix (QB23 vs SEA), Justin Herbert (QB25 @KC low total).
items.why: Tough matchups, shaky QB/usage, low totals
items.implication: Fade or sit in most formats
